base_prompt:
A single game UI piece for an all-ages mobile casual game, in EXACTLY the soft hand-painted style of the third attached image (rounded, gentle cel shading, soft light, no hard black outlines). Strictly original; no text, no characters, no icons.

ONE vertical lane GROOVE, 192x360 pixels, transparent background (PNG with alpha). It is a shallow, softly rounded channel pressed into a calm frosted blue-gray stage (the stage color is about #AAC1DD, see the lower part of the fourth image). Shape: a tall rounded capsule, 192 wide and 360 tall, both ends fully rounded (half circles), like a soft pill standing upright.

Look:
- The inside is only slightly darker and slightly cooler than the stage (about #9FB6D3 to #A6BCD8), slightly see-through so the stage shows through, evenly lit; no gradient stripes, no texture noise.
- A soft inner shadow hugging the top end and the upper part of both sides (the groove is pressed IN, light comes from the top), fading out smoothly toward the middle.
- A soft pale highlight lip along the bottom end and the lower part of both sides (light catching the far rim), thin and gentle, white at about 40% strength.
- No outer outline, no drop shadow outside the shape, no glass reflections, no shine streaks, no bubbles, no sparkles, no decorations, no saturated colors.
- Very calm and low contrast: game creatures and number tags are drawn on top of it and must stay the brightest things there.
- The middle section (from 90 px to 270 px of the height) must be vertically uniform (every row the same), because the game stretches that part vertically; all shaping detail of the ends stays within the top 88 px and the bottom 88 px.

Targeted refinement: the first four reference images have exactly the stated roles. The fifth image is the first generated groove draft; edit it. Keep its soft recessed top shadow and delicate bottom lip, but remove the fine shiny line that traces the outside of the shape. No lit contour around the top or vertical sides, no glass or rim tubing. The outer boundary is just a gentle alpha feather into nothing, with NO contrasting stroke. Any bottom light must lie just INSIDE the shape and fade away softly; a restrained diffuse white about40% strength, never an outline all around. The top edge is an inward dark soft shadow, never a bright top highlight.

Interior should be a neutral muted frosted blue-gray around RGB(160,183,213), NOT bright bluish glass. It is slightly transparent throughout the entire interior: target alpha170 of255 (about67% opacity), preserving actual transparency outside. The soft shadow lives inside the TOP cap, and the pale lip lives inside the BOTTOM cap. There must be obvious but gentle shallow concavity when composited over the stage color #AAC1DD; no convex puffiness.

Correct the proportions: this is a fairly WIDE vertical capsule, full silhouette about186 pixels wide by354 pixels high on a192x360 logical canvas, with only3px outer margins. Top and bottom each use a full rounded semicircular cap about88 logical pixels high. Not a very thin long pill. The middle remains completely vertically uniform, quiet neutral blue-gray with no texture grain or gradient striping. Slight hand-painted softness only in the end shadows and light, no saturated edge colors, no interface or surrounding background.
attempts.verdict: 未采用：端头柔和、材质可用，整理后舞台预览的竖向两侧仍有细亮线。

postprocessing_detail.method: Resample generated end caps into 88-pixel head/tail zones; median source strip supplies a single repeated center row; soften cap-to-center joins within the caps. Calibrate muted blue-gray RGB and face alpha, protect pale lip.

EDGE-ONLY CORRECTION: the first4 images have the roles given above. The FIFTH image is the exact current192x360 groove sprite to edit. KEEP its current neutral color,67.8% interior opacity, fully rounded silhouette, width, top recessed inner shading and bottom subtle inside lip. It already has the right overall recessed appearance. Change ONLY the following remaining flaw:

Remove the hairline bright contours along BOTH STRAIGHT VERTICAL SIDES. They currently look like fine glass borders. Along the entire middle between y=88 and272, the face color must extend quietly to a soft alpha edge with no brighter stroke, no white line, no dark line, no bevel line and no separate rim.
